stories.title: Live results, analysis for WWE Crown Jewel
stories.summary: ESPN recaps the action from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as WWE champions clashed for annual titles at Crown Jewel.

stories.title: Sources: Colts engaged in Jones trade talks as multiple teams inquire about QB
stories.summary: The Colts have engaged in trade discussions with multiple teams involving quarterback Daniel Jones, sources told NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: 'Angry' Rhule fires OC Holgorsen amid Huskers' 4-game losing streak
stories.summary: Nebraska's Matt Rhule has fired offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen after the Huskers have averaged just 13.5 points during a four-game Big Ten losing streak.

stories.title: Illini's Bielema jabs at CFP rankings: Would be top-15 team if we were in SEC
stories.summary: Big Ten coaches continue to be rankled by the initial College Football Playoff rankings, with Illinois coach Bret Bielema taking the latest veiled shot at the SEC.

stories.title: Man arrested on stalking charges at LeBron's home in Los Angeles
stories.summary: A man was arrested on Friday night at LeBron James' Brentwood, California, home, a Los Angeles Police Department spokesperson confirmed to ESPN on Saturday.
